out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink to the left of the 3 vat sink was being used to store a pitcher and a whisk.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HAND WASHING SINKS MUST ONLY BE USED FOR WASHING HANDS. THEY MUST ALWAYS BE AVAILABLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH THEIR HANDS AND PREVENT THE POTENTIAL SPREAD OF BACTERIA. PIC REMOVED THE PITCHER AND WHISK FROM THE HAND WASHING SINK.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked noodles hot holding in a steam well, was temping at 120F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HOT FOODS MUST BE HOT HELD AT A TEMPERATURE OF 135F OR HIGHER AT ALL TIMES. THE NOODLES HAD ONLY BEEN COOKED 30 MINS PRIOR TO INSPECTION. PIC REHEATED THE NOODLES ON THE FLAT TOP GRILL TO 165F BEOFRE PLACING THEM BACK IN THE STEAM WELL.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut cabbage mixture cut the day prior in the 4DWR under grill cooler was temping at 47F at the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS MUST BE COLD HELD AT 41F OR BELOW. DUE TO THE CUT CABBAGE BEING PREPARED THE DAY PRIOR, PIC THREW AWAY THE CUT CABBAGE MIXTURE THAT WAS TEMPING AT 47F AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: The 2DR prep top cooler was broken and not working at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. 2DR PREP TOP UNIT WAS NOT WORKING AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PIC WILL CALL A TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE UNIT. PIC WILL CONTACT EHS WHEN THE UNIT IS FIXED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PLEASE PROVIDE ‘HAND WASHING ONLY SIGNS’ AT EACH HAND SINK BY THE TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cream cheese and crab stick inside sushi cooler above 41f. Cooler was turned on in the morning.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI placed in flat top cooler to cool
